SELECT i_item_id, s_state, grouping(s_state) g_state, avg(ss_quantity) agg1, avg(ss_list_price) agg2, avg(ss_coupon_amt) agg3, avg(ss_sales_price) agg4
FROM store_sales
JOIN customer_demographics ON ss_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk
JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
JOIN store ON ss_store_sk = s_store_sk
JOIN item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
WHERE cd_gender = 'M' AND cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd_education_status = 'Secondary' AND d_year = 1999 AND s_state = 'TN'
GROUP BY i_item_id, s_state WITH ROLLUP
ORDER BY i_item_id, s_state
LIMIT 100
